integrity: The original codeword list is attributed to the authors, the claimed distance profile is verified by fully exhaustive independent direct and BFS computations; full source and input data are supplied.
scientific_limitations: Exact complete covering spectrum for the particular published 84-word binary length-22 code; does not prove a global optimum for the radius among all codes, a code family, or independent validation.
title: Complete covering-distance spectrum of a new binary length-22 code
